title: Help Desk Analyst
description:
The Help Desk Analyst is responsible for providing Level 1 and Level 2 support for FAST and its internal employees, partners, and customers. The Help Desk Analyst is the initial point of contact for many IT, DevOps, or infrastructure related issues, and offers issue classification, timely resolution or transfer to the appropriate parties, status updates, and clear and concise communication and documentation to end users.

  

* Provide Level 1 and Level 2 support that includes: performing initial ticket or task intake, providing regular and timely status updates, and transferring service requests to other teams or workgroups when appropriate.

* Assist in security, infrastructure, and general IT rollouts and implementation efforts

* Contribute current technical information and best practices to the knowledge base

* Participate in an on-call rotation to provide off-hours support to internal development teams and customers.

  

* Bachelor's degree preferred
* Previous experience in a Help Desk environment supporting computer software and hardware, and working within a ticketing or incident management platform
* Ability to manage multiple tasks with aggressive timelines
* Highly organized with the ability to prioritize demand for self in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent customer service and communication skills
* Strong written and verbal skills as well as problem solving skills

title: IT Network & Systems Administrator
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled IT Network & Systems Administrator to manage, maintain, and troubleshoot the organization's IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, hardware, software, and security systems. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth IT operations, network connectivity, system performance, and data security.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, and firewalls.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, and other IT hardware.
* Manage Windows Server, Linux Server, and Active Directory.
* Monitor network performance and ensure stable connectivity across office locations.
* Handle system backups, data recovery, antivirus, and security updates.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and connectivity-related issues.
* Manage user accounts, email access, permissions, and system configurations.
* Maintain IT inventory, software licenses, and asset records.
* Coordinate with internet service providers and third-party IT vendors.
* Ensure IT security policies and data protection standards are followed.
* Provide technical support to employees and resolve IT-related issues within defined timelines.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in IT, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in IT infrastructure, networking, or system administration.
* Good knowledge of LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall configuration.
* Hands-on experience with Windows Server and Active Directory.

Opplane helps organizations unlock the value of their data in a world increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence, connectivity, and regulation.

title: Jr. Desktop Support Engineer
description:
At Meazure Learning, we aim to empower open\-minded, inquisitive, and driven people, and we love how each new addition to the team adds to our culture. Here, you can positively impact the careers of millions of test\-takers and reshape the education technology landscape by working toward one vision:


“To provide life\-long learners across the globe the freedom to pursue their academic dreams and career aspirations safely, securely, and conveniently.”

* Location: HYDW

	+ Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and other common software applications.
	+ Experience with hardware troubleshooting and repair.
	+ Familiarity with network concepts and troubleshooting
	+ Understanding of Active Directory.
